title: Sea foam contains hemoglycin from cosmic dust
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36919-36929
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06881E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Julie E. M. McGeoch, Malcolm W. McGeoch
Sea foam is subjected to Folch extraction and mass spectrometry to isolate hemoglycin, an iron-terminated anti-parallel polymer of glycine first found in meteorites. The polymer has elevated isotope levels indicative of an origin in cosmic dust.
